function: Learns baseband and hybrid precoding policies (SE- and EE-maximal) for downlink MU-MISO with size-generalizable recursive GNNs (p. 3, p. 9).
system: Downlink MU-MISO, BS with N antennas and K single-antenna users, no RIS; hybrid precoding with Ns RF chains, mmWave Saleh-Valenzuela channel (p. 3, p. 15).
method: Recursive GNN (2D-RGNN, 3D-RGNN) with FNN processors and combiners; unsupervised learning with Adam; hybrid case trained at 10 dB, fine-tuned at 20 dB (p. 13, p. 16).
data_channel: Simulated uncorrelated Rayleigh fading (baseband) and Saleh-Valenzuela with Ncl=4, Nray=5 (hybrid); 100,000 training and 1,000 test samples per (N,K) pair (p. 13, p. 15).
test_conditions: Train: K exponential (mean 5), N=16; test: K 2-16. Train N 4-8, test N>8. Hybrid: train K<=4, test K 1-5 (p. 14, p. 16).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE, EE-numerical, manifold optimization (MO), OMP. Learned: 2D-Vanilla-GNN [16], edge-GAT [38], Model-GNN [25], 3D-Vanilla-GNN [18] (p. 13, p. 16).
metrics: SE ratio to WMMSE or MO, EE ratio, constraint satisfaction ratio; training samples, time, parameters; inference time and iterations (p. 13, p. 15).
complexity: FLOPs order O(L_F K^2 N^2 J^2) per 2D-RGNN layer (p. 13); inference time vs WMMSE and MO (Tables 4, 6, p. 15, p. 16); 55,476 parameters (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 13: "generated from uncorrelated Rayleigh fading channel"; hybrid case p. 15: "the Saleh-Valenzuela channel model". Own simulated channels; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 14: "In this case, 90% of the samples are with K < 8. The test samples are generated in the scenario with K ∼ U(2, 16)"; also N > 8 unseen in training (p. 14) and K=5 unseen in hybrid training (p. 16).
q3_support: p. 13: "by a numerical algorithm, which is selected as the WMMSE algorithm" (non-learned reference of the SE ratio); p. 13: "2D-Vanilla-GNN : This is the GNN designed in [16]" and Model-GNN [25] (earlier learned precoders), compared on SE ratio in Figs. 4-5.
q4_support: p. 13: "FLOPs for the ℓ-th 2D-RGNN layer is O(LF K 2 N 2 Jℓ2 )"; measured inference times against WMMSE and MO in Tables 4 and 6 (p. 15, p. 16).
q5_support: p. 13: "We generate 100,000 samples for every pair of N and K as" - the data are self-simulated; the paper gives no code or data link (only the CC licence URL on p. 1 and references on p. 21-22).
notes: RIS appears only in related work ([3], [17], p. 2). Area 3 because the learned method is the BS baseband/hybrid precoder; no sensing, no OTFS, no NTN, no over-the-air aggregation. Earlier conference version [1] (VTC Fall 2023) is cited on p. 3. Channels are custom Rayleigh and Saleh-Valenzuela, so q1 is 0.
